metadata.description: Onboards new project directories and retires finished ones.

plugins.name: project-optimizer
plugins.description: Offers onboarding the first time Claude Code runs in a directory: scopes plugins and MCP servers to the project, writes or improves CLAUDE.md, checks directory organization, and verifies GitHub configuration. Includes a read-only audit with a batch mode, and an archive workflow that inventories every store holding a project's state before anything is removed.
